classes.student_input: may reach a deployed model (world model or policy) as an input, within its role's offsets; available at test time on every map through the bridge; never absolute
classes.teacher_input: privileged; may reach a teacher model only, never a deployed student
classes.aux_target: loss side only (targets, auxiliary targets, masks); never an input to any role
classes.eval_only: evaluation, stratification and bookkeeping; never an input and never a target

roles.world_model: the DriveDiT world model: a transition is (obs_t, action_cmd applied over the decision interval (P_t, P_t+1], obs_t+1)
roles.policy: the driving policy: predicts action_label at t from inputs at <= t, with action history <= t-1
roles.teacher: a privileged or bidirectional teacher used only for training (never deployed)

offsets.decision_step_rule: decision step t is the decision callback C_t, the first fixed-frame callback at or past world-time grid point t (every 1000 / decision_hz ms from the first ctl row), P_t its physics_step; the HL decides after the rows of C_t from that row's state, and the command applies from physics step P_t + 1 through the next decision callback (the decision interval (P_t, P_t+1], nominally N = physics_steps_per_decision steps; streams JSON timing)
offsets.zero: offset 0 = the value at t: for state, nav and image the state of decision callback C_t; for action_cmd the command applied over (P_t, P_t+1]; for action_exec the executed values of steps P_t + 1 .. P_t + N
offsets.max_offset: an input may use offsets <= max_offset; null with input true = unbounded within the clip (teacher only)

override_10hz.rule: the non-default 10 Hz session setting (clocks.image_hz_setting trial_conf, TBD-2): image and decision rate 10 Hz, because the decision interval is the image interval (r2 3.5); tensor names stay, action_cmd stays [T,3]

rules: Only student_input channels reach a deployed model (L3); the builder (DD-11) enforces the offsets and C24 checks them (DD-5).
The world model conditions on action_cmd at offset 0 and on state history; it is never conditioned on realised future state.
The policy sees action_cmd and action_exec only as history (offset <= -1); state, nav and style at offset <= 0.
aux_target channels are never inputs; eval_only channels are never inputs or targets.
No student_input channel is absolute (world-frame pose, heading, velocity, altitude, map or build identity).
build_scoped channels are raw engine inputs and are never pooled across build_keys (MIGRATION_1_9 3.2).
pin_id and build_key are eval_only: no model-visible build token (MIGRATION_1_9 2.2).

c24_forbidden_inputs.meaning: map_id, absolute pose, altitude, distance_total, world-frame heading/velocity, hindsight goals and anchors (including planned-time goals at +2/+4/+6 s), anything derived from future telemetry, and build or session identity (r2 2.3 L3, 3.3; MIGRATION_1_9 2.2)

tensors.name: image
tensors.rule: R1 derivative 512x288; photometric augmentation on uint8 before normalisation; no flips (RT-X06). obs_t is the newest image whose pose row (hf row captured_render_frame + 1) has last_physics_step <= P_t and whose captured frame is at or before the render frame of C_t (never a future image); t is dropped (wm_valid = policy_valid = 0) if that image is older than one image period. The builder records the realised age per decision step (derived decision_index).

tensors.name: state
tensors.rule: Values at <= t only: telemetry_export of decision callback C_t (P_t), the state after its steps, which holds no step of action_cmd_t. The world model is never conditioned on realised future state.

channels.name: acc_long_achieved_mps2
channels.desc: Achieved longitudinal acceleration (separate from the desired a_target).

tensors.name: action_cmd
tensors.rule: What was executed through llc_v1 over the decision interval (P_t, P_t+1]: ctl.hl_* of the row after C_t, the command decided after the rows of C_t. World model: conditioning at offset 0. Policy: history only (offset <= -1).

tensors.name: action_label
tensors.rule: The expert's HL command at t: ctl.exp_*_now of C_t, evaluated on the state of that row (the state the policy sees). Equals action_cmd in mode E; differs in N/D. The policy's prediction target; never an input.

tensors.name: action_exec
tensors.rule: Optional diagnostic / world-model ablation: the llc output and input_post of the physics steps P_t + 1 .. P_t + N, each from the ctl row that covers it (frame-bound rows: a row covers covered_steps steps); entries past P_t+1 empty (N = physics_steps_per_decision, TBD-1: 6 at 5 Hz, 3 at the 10 Hz override). Raw engine inputs: build-scoped, never pooled across builds. Policy: history only.

tensors.name: nav
tensors.rule: drivedit_nav.nav_v1(route, pose) at the pose of C_t (P_t) (one function for the harvester, the builder and the bridge; C22). Distance-based route points, never time-based or hindsight goals (RT-C03). nav_valid 0 (more than 30 m off the route) sets policy_valid and wm_valid to 0.

channels.name: p20_x
channels.desc: Route point 20 m ahead, ego forward.

channels.name: p20_y
channels.desc: Route point 20 m ahead, ego right.

channels.name: p40_x
channels.desc: Route point 40 m ahead, ego forward.

channels.name: p40_y
channels.desc: Route point 40 m ahead, ego right.

channels.name: d_stop
channels.desc: Distance to the next commanded stop, 0-200; 200 = none.

tensors.name: style
tensors.rule: style_v1 per episode; nominal (1.0, 0.0 m, 2.75 m/s2) at evaluation.

tensors.name: masks
tensors.rule: Loss and sampling masks; never a model input and never a prediction target.

channels.name: policy_valid
channels.desc: Built by the builder: 0 for X/A rows, while a reaction to an actor with ctl.react_visible 0 lasts (the in-engine visibility test of r2 3.1; reserved until DD-4/DD-7), for nav_valid 0, for decision steps without a valid image (decision_index.obs_valid 0, C29) and for every decision step whose decision interval (P_t, P_t+1] contains or follows the earliest onset of the episode's terminal ego crash events (dc-2.0 9.5.1; wm_valid stays 1 there).

channels.name: wm_valid
channels.desc: 0 across gaps, fiducial failures, teleports, nav_valid 0 and decision_index.obs_valid 0.

channels.name: env_transition
channels.desc: 1 for 15 s after an environment change.

channels.name: teleport
channels.desc: 1 at a teleport or respawn of the ego (or of no vehicle, veh_slot_id -1); a traffic reset never masks ego samples (dc-2.0 9.5.1).

tensors.name: hindsight_anchors
tensors.rule: Ego-frame positions of the logged trajectory at +2/+4/+6 s: future information, aux target only, on C24's forbidden-input list (RT-C03).

tensors.name: future_pose
tensors.rule: Ego-frame pose deltas at +1..+H decision steps (H set by the builder); aux target only.

tensors.name: road_context
tensors.rule: Road context from the matched graph and the route; aux target only (r2 3.3).

tensors.name: contact_events
tensors.rule: Contact events in [t, t+dt); aux target only. Depth targets are disabled (r2 8 R31).

channels.name: contact_event
channels.desc: 1 when an ego collision row (its payload onset_step, dc-2.0 9.5.1) falls in the interval.

channels.name: contact_class
channels.desc: The collision payload other (vehicle, character, tree, building, rock, terrain, static, dynamic, unknown; categorical).

tensors.name: privileged_route
tensors.rule: Privileged geometry for a teacher only (capture-protocol 4.2 'privileged' layer); never a student input.

channels.name: lead_gap_m
channels.desc: Gap to the lead vehicle in the lane corridor.

tensors.name: eval_only
tensors.rule: Evaluation, stratification and bookkeeping only; never an input and never a target.

channels.name: pin_id
channels.desc: Pin id; never a model-visible build token.

channels.name: build_key
channels.source: session.json pin.build_key, else the harvester's harvest.json
channels.desc: Build identity; never a model-visible build token.

channels.name: exp_now_60hz
channels.desc: Per-callback expert re-evaluation (ctl.exp_*_now of every row; named for the r2 60 Hz step), diagnostics only.
